# Home Energy Savings

> > A comprehensive resource for residential energy efficiency rebates and incentives across multiple U.S. states, featuring programs from Rocky Mountain Power and ENERGY STAR certified upgrades.

Home Energy Savings helps homeowners discover and apply for energy efficiency rebates on HVAC systems, appliances, and home improvements. The site covers state-specific programs in Idaho, California, Wyoming, and other regions, with detailed contractor requirements and application guidance.

## Key Topics

- ENERGY STAR certification
- Rocky Mountain Power programs
- Idaho Public Utilities Commission
- HVAC efficiency rebates
- Duct sealing incentives
- Central air conditioning upgrades
- Refrigerator and appliance rebates
- Home insulation programs
- Contractor requirements
- Energy efficiency incentives
- California rebate programs
- Wyoming energy programs
- Appliance recycling
- Cooling cost reduction
- Residential energy savings

## HVAC Systems & Efficiency

- [Duct Sealing](https://www.homeenergysavings.net/Idaho/hvac/ductsealing): Idaho duct sealing rebates via Rocky Mountain Power program
- [Central Air Conditioners](https://www.homeenergysavings.net/California/hvac/centralac): California ENERGY STAR central AC rebates and contractor requirements

## Appliance Rebates

- [Refrigerators](https://www.homeenergysavings.net/Idaho/appliances/refrigerators): Idaho refrigerator rebates through Rocky Mountain Power program

## Application Support & State Programs

- [Wyoming Application Tips](https://www.homeenergysavings.net/apply_subdomain/preapp/Wyoming/DisplayTips): Wyoming application tips and pre-submission instructions for rebates
